scripts.dev: npm run dev:clean && npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$processIds = @(3000) | ForEach-Object { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique } | Where-Object { $_ }; foreach ($processId in $processIds) { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
